checkpoint_selection: Use the completed recovery report only when selected_checkpoint_reload_verified is true; bind its path, hash, selected checkpoint path, and manifest hash in selection_binding.
contamination_limit: The exclusion rebind reports zero excluded identifiers/groups, but the attached lexical-overlap report is bound to a previous training snapshot. No fresh exact/lexical overlap audit was run against the current snapshot; semantic overlap and pretrained-model exposure remain unknown.

exclusion_rebind.current_inference_authorization: explicit user authorization for this frozen evaluation

inference.choice_mask: Mask logits at indices greater than or equal to the row's option count.
inference.kind: decision-head multiple-choice classification; no text generation
inference.prediction: Argmax over valid choice logits; ties resolve to the lowest zero-based index.
inference.tokenizer: Use the tokenizer saved in each selected checkpoint; require identical tokenizer artifact hashes across candidates.

prompt_format.choice_order: Canonical source order after the pinned deterministic adapter; do not shuffle, relabel, or permute.
prompt_format.empty_context: Keep the Context: line even when context is empty.

report_gate: Write final aggregate metrics only after both locked candidates finish the exact canonical item set.

resumption.cursor: Canonical bundle file ordinal; persist aggregate sufficient statistics atomically after each committed item.
resumption.normal_pause: Honor stop requests at the next item boundary and resume from the next uncommitted ordinal.
resumption.unclean_interruption: Never replay an item whose inference may have started; halt with an indeterminate safe status if an in-flight marker remains.

scoring.groups: Overall plus each pinned source slice; report the five Belebele language slices separately and do not describe translated variants as independent problems.
scoring.multiclass_brier_score: Mean sum_j((p_j - y_j)^2) over valid choices, where y is one-hot gold.
scoring.negative_log_likelihood: Mean -log(p_gold) for the one-hot gold choice.
scoring.probabilities: Softmax over valid masked choice logits; no temperature scaling or calibration.
scoring.uniform_baseline: Per-item expected accuracy 1/K, NLL log(K), and multiclass Brier score 1 - 1/K for K valid choices; aggregate by the same source slices.

suite_reuse.comparison_note: Same canonical suite, base model revision, formatter, and scoring method as the earlier evaluation. The selected current-corpus checkpoint and training snapshot differ; comparisons are descriptive, not causal. No test results were used for selection or tuning.
